name: Latvian National Museum of Art — works documented by Ars Accordia
name_lv: Latvijas Nacionālā mākslas muzeja — Ars Accordia reģistrs

scope.definition: Works held by the Latvijas Nacionālais mākslas muzejs (LNMM) catalogued by Ars Accordia for the public registry. Framed as Ars Accordia's own catalogue — not a commissioned assessment of the museum. No total_extent: coverage percentage is not claimed.
scope.source: Ars Accordia registry. Primary source for catalogued works: Lamberga, Dace (comp.). Mākslinieks. Portrets. Pašportrets. Rīga: LNMM; Neputns, 2009. (SRC-LNMM-PORTRAITS-2009)

listing.description: Portrait and self-portrait collection of the Latvian National Museum of Art, scoped to works documented in the 2009 exhibition catalogue 'Mākslinieks. Portrets. Pašportrets'.

_notes: 6 passports scored. The SRC-LNMM-PORTRAITS-2009 provenance citation was removed from all six works on verification: that book documents a 2009 portrait exhibition, not the LNMM permanent collection, and could not be confirmed as a source for these specific holdings' provenance. Current location remains confirmed via LNMM open data (Google Arts & Culture, Wikidata).
